Elgin Council hereby receives the report from Terri Towstiuc, Manager of Community Services/Clerk Re: Procedural By-law – Public Attendance Sign-In Requirement; And
That Council hereby repeal Resolution No. 2026-292, passed October 22, 2026, which directed staff to include a public attendance sign-in log requirement in the 2026 Procedural By-law; And
That Council confirm that Resolution No. 2026-293, approving the 2026 Procedural By-law and directing its implementation effective November 15, 2026, remains in effect, subject to the removal of any mandatory public attendance sign-in requirement.
Carried

Notice of Motions
6.1
R Statham Motion One (1) - Reserve Fund Overview and Purpose
That West Elgin Council direct the Treasurer, in consultation with the CAO, to prepare and present a consolidated report providing incoming Council with an overview of the Municipality's reserve funds and reserve balances; And
That the report shall include:
A summary of each municipal reserve and reserve fund, identifying its current balance as of the most recent available reporting date, and, where readily available, its opening balance for the current year and any significant contributions or withdrawals during the year.
Where applicable, an identification of amounts within each reserve that have already been allocated or committed to Council-approved projects, obligations or other purposes, distinguishing those amounts from the uncommitted balance.
A review of the existing purpose and intended use of each reserve and reserve fund, including identification of those for which no specific purpose or guiding description has been formally established.
